mapper.update: UPDATE generation_request SET task_id = #{taskId} WHERE id = #{requestId} AND task_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_task( user_id, request_id, request_key, request_digest, application_id, application_name, application_version, model_version, image_size, output_count, prompt, negative_prompt, grant_id, frozen_units, state, accounting_state ) VALUES ( #{task.userId}, #{task.requestId}, #{task.requestKey}, #{task.requestDigest}, #{task.applicationId}, #{task.applicationName}, #{task.applicationVersion}, #{task.modelVersion}, #{task.imageSize}, #{task.outputCount}, #{task.prompt}, #{task.negativePrompt}, #{task.grantId}, #{task.frozenUnits}, #{task.state}, #{task.accountingState} )

(#{taskId}, #{mediaId}, #{position})
INSERT INTO generation_task_handoff(task_id, state, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, 'PENDING', NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task SET state_note = #{note} WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM generation_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE generation_task SET state = #{state}, accounting_state = #{accounting}, state_note = #{note}, delivered_at = IF(#{state} = 'SUCCEEDED', NOW(3), delivered_at), settled_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND accounting_state = 'FROZEN' AND state IN
#{allowed}

UPDATE generation_task SET state = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', state_note = #{note} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND accounting_state = 'FROZEN' AND state NOT IN ('RESULT_PENDING','FAILED_PENDING_FOLLOWUP', 'CANCELLED_PENDING_FOLLOWUP','QUEUE_TIMEOUT','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM generation_task WHERE accounting_state = 'FROZEN' AND state IN ('FAILED_PENDING_FOLLOWUP','CANCELLED_PENDING_FOLLOWUP','QUEUE_TIMEOUT', 'RESULT_PENDING','REVIEW','CANCEL_REQUESTED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task WHERE accounting_state = #{accounting}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task WHERE state = #{state}
